about.title: About Me
about.description:
I come from a tech background — I build websites and apps for businesses. One day a friend needed help buying property, and I realised I actually enjoy the process. Fast forward to today: I've helped over 100 clients across 5+ property projects.

I'm not the type to push you into signing anything. I'll walk you through your options, give you what you need to know, and let you decide on your own terms. That's what "don't rush" means to me.

property.title: Property Advisory
property.description: Buying property in Malaysia? I'll help you understand the market, compare launches, pick the right unit, and sort out the paperwork — booking to keys. No pressure. Just straight answers.

digital.title: Digital Solutions
digital.description: Need a website or app for your business? I build modern digital products with real business sense — not just pretty pixels.
